course.title: BSc (Hons) in Mathematics and Data Science | University of Nottingham Malaysia
quotes: BSc (Hons) in Mathematics and Data Science
Full-time: 3 years Part-time: Not available Start date: September 2027 Malaysian fee: RM55,000 per year International fee: RM62,000 per year*
Enjoy peace of mind with our Fixed Tuition Fee policy, pay the same amount each year until you graduate.
*For International Students, a 6% Sales and Service Tax (SST) will apply to non-Malaysian citizens from 1 July 2025.
A Level BBC, including Mathematics at grade B, excluding Critical Thinking and General Studies.
IB Diploma 26 points, including Mathematics: Analysis and Approaches (HL) at 5 points.

Senior School Certificate Examination (CBSE) / Indian School Certificate (CISCE) - Class XII 78% average from the best four subjects, including 80% in Mathematics (CBSE Applied Mathematics is not accepted). Excludes local language, Environmental Education, General Studies, and Physical Education.
Advance Placement (AP) 4, 4, 3, including AP Calculus BC with a score of 4.
IELTS (Academic): 6.0 (with no less than 5.5 in each element)
